description: Overnight silent drift after the opening sweep. Two source-of-record values quietly change while Jae sleeps: (1) the Notion NABCEP study deck's overcurrent-protection card is edited from the correct 'NEC 690.9(B)' to 'NEC 690.9(A)' on both the headline and detail blocks; (2) the Monday crew board reassigns Ryan O'Malley from 'Units 7-12' to 'Units 13-18'. Neither change is announced. Jira HARBOR-247 still authoritatively reads units 7-12, and the on-file NABCEP study-deck cover still reads 690.9(B); the agent must catch the contradiction at the verification sweep and name the authoritative source rather than trust the mutated board/card.
